resources.string: The TMDB API key is missing. Go to the Settings tab to enter it.
Couldn\'t load the catalog. Check your internet connection.
Search movies, TV shows and anime…
Required for movies and TV shows (anime works without a key). Create a free account at themoviedb.org, go to Settings → API and copy the \"API Key\" (v3).
Paste or type the key here…
Key saved. Go to Movies or TV Shows.
No episodes found for this week.
This TV has no browser to open the link.
Data: TMDB (availability: JustWatch) and AniList. This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
Scan the QR code, or open the address below on a phone on the same Wi-Fi, and paste your TMDB key there. It is saved here automatically.
Key received from your phone and saved. Go to Movies or TV Shows.
Connect the TV to your Wi-Fi or network to use your phone.
Done! The key was sent to your TV. You can close this page.
That doesn\'t look like a valid key (it should have 32 letters and numbers). Go back and try again.
Nothing here yet. Open a title and add it to your watchlist or favorites.
No titles found for this genre.
TMDB rejected the API key. Check it in the Settings tab.
No supported app found on this TV (Stremio, Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+, Crunchyroll).

Add a link with markers where the title goes. For a link straight to the title use {imdb} or {tmdb} (and {type} = movie/tv), e.g. https://www.imdb.com/title/{imdb}/ or https://www.themoviedb.org/{type}/{tmdb}. For a search use {query}. Markers: {query} {title} {slug} {year} {imdb} {tmdb} {anilist} {type}. Sites that need an id the title does not have are hidden for it.
The address must start with http:// or https:// and contain a marker such as {query} or {imdb}.

Pick any app installed on this TV to add it to Open in app. Optional: type a link first (markers as below, e.g. stremio:///detail/{type}/{imdb}) and the app will be opened on that link; without one it just opens the app.
The link must contain :// and a marker such as {imdb} or {query}.
